thresholds.statistic: Fleiss kappa over left/right/tie is predeclared and reported with raw pairwise agreement. Side-swapped duplicates symmetrise left/right category prevalence; tie remains an explicit third category.
thresholds.failureConsequence: Any failed qualification, envelope, side-swap, pairwise, kappa, or majority-support threshold keeps the performance key sealed and yields no relative result.

RATER-PAIR-V1-A.gold: Act as independent calibrated rater RATER-PAIR-V1-A. Open only recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/gold/blind-packet/packet.json, recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/gold/templates/rater-pair-v1-a.json, recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/grade.schema.json, and images referenced by the packet. Grade all 48 rows in exact order using left|right|tie, confidence, and concrete rationale; never inspect keys, parent directories, prior grades, or other raters. Write only recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/gold/submissions/rater-pair-v1-a.json and run npx tsx recipe/input-field-paired-comparison-v1.ts --preflight recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/gold/submissions/rater-pair-v1-a.json. Stop after GOLD until a passing qualification receipt is issued.
RATER-PAIR-V1-A.performance: Only after recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/gold/receipts/rater-pair-v1-a.json proves >=95% GOLD and all clear winners correct, open recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/performance/blind-packet/packet.json, recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/performance/templates/rater-pair-v1-a.json, recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/grade.schema.json, that receipt, and packet-referenced images. Grade all 256 tasks independently in exact order. Choose which candidate is closer even if both fail absolutely; tie only within the explicit tolerances. Write only recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/performance/submissions/rater-pair-v1-a.json and run npx tsx recipe/input-field-paired-comparison-v1.ts --preflight recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/performance/submissions/rater-pair-v1-a.json. Never inspect recipe/evidence/input-field-paired-comparison-v1/performance/sealed-answer-key.json, compare tasks, infer candidate or hidden-control identity, access prior rounds, or communicate with another rater.

claims.canProveAfterReliableGrades: relative fidelity preference between unchanged recipe and legacy candidates over all 128 exact cells
claims.cannotProve: absolute recognisability, Input success, live canvas usability, generality beyond this denominator, or permission to begin live work

requirements: Recruit fresh independent raters with no access to prior submissions, receipts, GOLD keys, or performance artifacts.
Create a qualification-only replacement packet with fresh opaque task, reference, candidate, pair, and randomized-order bindings; lock its sealed GOLD key before rater access.
Use the unchanged rubric, 48-row denominator, >=95% GOLD threshold, every clear winner correct requirement, exact envelope validation, and no waivers.
Write replacement templates, submissions, and receipts under gold/replacements/round-1 without overwriting any original artifact.
Commission performance only after the retained qualifiers plus all replacement slots form a three-rater passing cohort with hash-bound performance templates.
